verdicts.why: In the post-credits scene of Into the Spider-Verse, Miguel O'Hara travels to Earth-67 and argues with its Spider-Man. Earth-6799 is not the name the film uses.
Their connection starts in Daredevil S1. In S1#1 Mahoney tips Foggy off about Karen's murder arrest, and in S1#9 he speaks with Karen at the morgue about Elena Cardenas.

In Born Again S2#3 North escorts a blindfolded McDuffie to Duquesne, who is her client, and gives her fifteen minutes with him. She tells North that the unreasonable access to counsel is illegal, so Duquesne is not denied a lawyer.
In Born Again S2#7 Blake lets BB escape. Cashman tortures him, Blake refuses to give up her location, and Cashman kills him. BB was already known as the leaker in S2#6.
Alisa dies in Jessica Jones S2 long before Danielle appears, and the two never meet. A blood tie with someone never met is not a connection.

In Luke Cage S1#8 Diamondback attacks the clinic from outside, takes down the wounded Luke, drags Misty outside, takes her gun and holds it to her head hoping she will beg. She does not ambush him, and he does not shoot Luke while holding her.
In Market Forces Robbie Robertson is the Bugle's assistant editor, and Jameson runs the paper. The text wrongly calls Robbie editor in chief.
The crime bosses' meeting happens in Luke Cage S2#12, and Mariah is arrested at the end of that episode. In S2#13 Rosalie joins the war for Harlem while Mariah is in prison.
In Born Again S1#1, after winning the election, Fisk tells Vanessa he knows she had an affair with Adam while he was away. This betrayal is missing from their stages.
In Born Again S2#4 a shard of the ornament Fisk shatters hits Vanessa in the head. In S2#5 she keeps asking Fisk to tell how they met, then dies. A death is a stage.

In AoS S4#11 Fitz finds that Radcliffe caused Aida's malfunction, and Simmons joins Coulson's team to arrest him at his home. The man they arrest is his LMD. The ally-to-enemy turn happens here, not at S4#17.

In Partners (#46) Alistair, as Silvermane's top scientist, kidnaps the Black Cat and forces Spider-Man to capture the Scorpion or the Vulture for their DNA in exchange for her release. The current text leaves out what happens between them.

value.on_a_card_about_b: A former Oscorp intern, secretly Spider-Man, who quits and stops trusting Norman.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's former mentor at Oscorp, whose lies cost him Peter's trust.

verdicts.why: In #10 Peter quits the internship and can no longer trust Norman after the Project Monolith lies. That clearly turns the relationship, and 'Norman's intern' and 'Peter's mentor' are no longer true. Rival is the only listed kind for two people at odds who are not open enemies.

Stage 0 rests only on Kamala's nightmares of a red figure. Visions and dreams are not events between people, and Blade naming Wanda in #2 is only a story told about her. They first meet at New Asgard in #3.
